description:
Gulf Futurism is a hypermodern art movement emerging from the Gulf states, centering primarily on the futuristic vision and technological development of the Arabian Gulf region, as well as the region’s role in globalization and the technological revolution.

On the one hand, the scenarios depicted in Gulf Futurism are largely exaggerated. Through the excessive deployment of technology, they interweave rampant consumerism and urban expansion with the alienation of the individual. On the other hand, Gulf Futurism blends tradition and the future to create a brand-new artistic language, infusing new vitality and imagination into the cultural confidence of the Arabian Gulf region. culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Hypermodernity, paradox of prosperity, globalization, surrealism
